name: New Relic
label: New Relic NerdGraph + Event API
description: New Relic NerdGraph via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/apis/nerdgraph/get-started/introduction-new-relic-nerdgraph/. Operations: nrql_query (POST /graphql), event_ingest, deploy_marker, alert_policy_get, incident_get, listen. event_ingest uses per-op baseUrl https://insights-collector.newrelic.com and path /v1/accounts/{accountId}/events (https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/data-apis/ingest-apis/event-api/introduction-event-api/). REST API v2 and Deployments v0 EOL 2027-07-31 (https://docs.newrelic.com/eol/2026/07/eol-31-07-26-rest-api-v2/); /alerts_policies/* is not impacted. Auth secret user_api_key is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: nrql_query | event_ingest | deploy_marker | alert_policy_get | incident_get | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'nrql_query'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: NerdGraph GraphQL query for nrql_query. Example: { actor { account(id: 1) { nrql(query: "SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction") { results } } } }.

schema.label: app_id
schema.description: APM application id for deploy_marker. Example: 123456789.

schema.label: eventType
schema.description: Required on each object in events (Event API name; alphanumeric, colon, underscore; max 255). When events is an object this named field is merged at the root. Example: Purchase.

schema.label: events
schema.description: event_ingest body: JSON array sent as the whole POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/events payload. Each object requires eventType (alphanumeric, colon, underscore; max 255). Attribute values are string or number only. Example: [{"eventType":"Purchase","amount":259.54}]. https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/data-apis/ingest-apis/event-api/introduction-event-api/

schema.label: events_json
schema.description: event_ingest: JSON array as text when agent tools cannot send array-typed events (coerced to events). Example: [{"eventType":"Purchase","amount":1}].

schema.label: incident_id
schema.description: incident_get path id (REST v2 alerts incident). Agent alias incidentId accepted. Example: 123456789.

schema.label: filter_name
schema.description: alert_policy_get: policy name filter (maps to query filter[name]).

schema.label: accountId
schema.description: New Relic account id (event_ingest path). Falls back to configuration accountId.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: nrql_query, event_ingest, deploy_marker, alert_policy_get, incident_get, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: User Api Key
configurationParameters.description: New Relic user API key (NerdGraph and REST v2). Header API-Key. event_ingest uses license_key instead when it is set. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: License Key
configurationParameters.description: New Relic ingest license key for event_ingest (Event API). Sent as the API-Key header on that call only; a user key is rejected by the Event API. Never logged. Example: a 40-character key ending in NRAL from API keys > Ingest - License.

configurationParameters.label: Data region
configurationParameters.description: Match the region of your New Relic account and API key. EXACT: us | eu. US uses api.newrelic.com; EU uses api.eu.newrelic.com and the EU Event API collector.

configurationParameters.label: Accountid
configurationParameters.description: Account id for NRQL and ingest.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
